indicators.name: Global Liquidity (G3 proxy) · 3-mo RoC
indicators.detail: Fed + ECB + BoJ balance sheets in USD: $17.38T. Prior reading -1.39%. A full 21-central-bank index is paywalled; the G3 make up the bulk of it and move with it.

indicators.name: Spot BTC ETF Net Flows
indicators.trigger: Green on 5 straight days of net inflows averaging ≥ +$200M/day.

indicators.name: Stablecoin Supply & SSR
indicators.detail: USDT + USDC $252B (-2.4% 30d). All USD stablecoins $300B. SSR 30d change -0.7% (lower = more dry powder vs BTC's size).

indicators.name: Long-Term Holder Selling (LTH-SOPR)
indicators.detail: 7-day avg, data through Oct 22 (free feed runs ~1 week behind). Long-term holders are still taking profits; prior week 1.156. Free stand-in for LTH Net Position Change; add GLASSNODE_API_KEY for the exact metric.

indicators.name: Perp Funding Rate (per 8h)
indicators.detail: 7-day average ≈ +8.4% annualized. 0.01% per 8h is the exchange default 'baseline long bias'.
indicators.trigger: Green at ≤ 0.005% per 8h (neutral or negative: speculative longs flushed).
